name: tracker-legacy-dispatch-rollback
goal: Fence legacy dispatcher rollback while native-owned work can still run, then preserve pinned legacy run rows and startup fingerprints on the same database.

evidence: Pinned legacy dispatcher starts queued runs using the current item token without understanding a native attempt key. Quiesce the native worker and refuse same-database legacy rollback until all native attempts are settled.
The existing claim and atomic transition method case checked legacy readers and invalidated native metadata; it did not exercise rollback admission for queued, running, verifying, and completed rows.
